title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
description: Google announced a unified agent in Gemini that can take on multi-step work, rolling out to businesses first and consumers later. It selects a model by default, and users can pick third-party models, starting with Anthropic's Claude.

title: OpenAI revenue falls short, models play hopscotch and Trump cracks down on tech green cards
description: SiliconANGLE's weekly roundup covers OpenAI's annualized revenue coming in below what it had signaled, which pressured AI-linked tech stocks. It also touches on recent model releases and new US restrictions affecting tech-sector green cards.

title: China's Manus raises over $500M in first funding round since split with Meta
description: AI agent developer Manus raised more than $500M in its first round since separating from Meta, at a reported valuation of about $4B. It also launched Cue, an app giving personal agents their own email, phone number, wallet and computer.

title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
description: Nous Research confirmed a $1.5B valuation after raising $90M and is moving into enterprise with Hermes for Businesses. The launch extends its open-model work into agents for business users.

title: Vesta raises $30M to bring swarms of agents to mortgage lenders
description: Vesta raised $30M to deploy swarms of AI agents that automate mortgage origination for lenders. The round reflects growing adoption of agents in regulated financial workflows.
